records.name: MHMR Tarrant Crisis Line and Mobile Crisis Outreach
records.organization: My Health My Resources (MHMR) of Tarrant County
records.description_en: A 24-hour phone and text line for a mental health or substance use crisis. A mobile crisis team can also meet people in person in Tarrant County.
records.description_es: Una línea de teléfono y de mensajes de texto, abierta las 24 horas, para crisis de salud mental o de consumo de drogas o alcohol. Un equipo móvil de crisis también puede verle en persona en el condado de Tarrant.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Tarrant County having a mental health or substance use crisis, including children, teens, and adults.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en el condado de Tarrant que esté pasando por una crisis de salud mental o de consumo de drogas o alcohol. Incluye niños, adolescentes y adultos.
records.how_to_apply: Call or text 1-800-866-2465 any time, day or night. If someone is in danger right now, call 911. You can also call or text 988.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un texto al 1-800-866-2465 a cualquier hora, de día o de noche. Si alguien está en peligro ahora mismo, llame al 911. También puede llamar o mandar un texto al 988.
records.hours: 24 hours a day, 365 days a year
records.notes: Phone, text option, 24/7 hours, and mobile crisis team (children, adolescents, adults throughout Tarrant County) confirmed on the crisis services page. TTY/TDD for hearing impaired: 817-569-4488. General service info: 817-335-3022. Cost is not stated on the page; crisis line is a public hotline.

records.how_to_apply: Call 817-335-3022 to start services. Adult new-patient intake is held at each center on set days from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m., for example the South Center (1200 Circle Drive, Fort Worth) on Monday and Friday.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 817-335-3022 para empezar. Los adultos nuevos pueden inscribirse en cada centro ciertos días, de 8 a.m. a 2 p.m. Por ejemplo, en el Centro Sur (1200 Circle Drive, Fort Worth) los lunes y viernes.

Sanford Suite 11, Arlington 76011) Mon & Fri; West (6777 Camp Bowie Blvd Suite 600, Fort Worth 76116) Thu & Fri; North (4525 City Point Dr, North Richland Hills 76180) Wed & Fri

Child and family centers: North (Keller) 6032 Innovation Way, Fort Worth 76244; East 601 W Sanford St Suite 201, Arlington 76011; Central 1527 Hemphill St, Fort Worth 76104; West 6777 Camp Bowie Blvd Suite 500, Fort Worth 76116. Sliding-scale fee was not confirmed on the pages read, so cost is left blank; call to ask. Call first to confirm whether intake is walk-in or by appointment.

records.name: JPS Connection
records.organization: JPS Health Network (Tarrant County Hospital District)
records.description_en: A medical assistance program for Tarrant County residents. Members get health care from JPS at a lower cost based on income.
records.description_es: Un programa de ayuda médica para residentes del condado de Tarrant. Los miembros reciben atención de salud en JPS a un costo más bajo, según sus ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Uninsured Tarrant County residents with household income at or below 250% of the federal poverty level. There are also supplemental plans for people with Medicare or other insurance under 250%. If you qualify for Affordable Care Act insurance or other state or federal help, you must sign up for that first.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes del condado de Tarrant sin seguro médico, con ingresos del hogar iguales o menores al 250% del nivel federal de pobreza. También hay planes adicionales para personas con Medicare u otro seguro con ingresos menores al 250%. Si usted califica para un seguro de la Ley de Cuidado de Salud Asequible (ACA) u otra ayuda estatal o federal, primero debe inscribirse en esa ayuda.
documents_needed: Picture ID (government, school, or work ID)
Birth certificates for all child dependents
Proof of income for all household members
Bank statements for the last 30 days (if self-employed, a homeowner, or receiving Social Security)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online, or send your application and documents by email (enroll@jpshealth.org), fax (817-702-3834), or mail to the JPS Enrollment & Eligibility Center, 101 W. Allen Ave, Fort Worth, TX 76110. Call 817-702-1001 for help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud por internet, o mande su solicitud y documentos por correo electrónico (enroll@jpshealth.org), por fax (817-702-3834) o por correo a JPS Enrollment & Eligibility Center, 101 W. Allen Ave, Fort Worth, TX 76110. Llame al 817-702-1001 si necesita ayuda.
records.notes: Fixed apply_url (was ola.verityscore.com, which does not resolve; the JPS page links ola.veritysource.com/jps, confirmed live). Plan levels: Connection 1 (under 21% FPL, homeless, uninsured), Connection 2 (below 100% FPL, uninsured), Connection 3 (101-250% FPL, uninsured), plus supplemental plans for Medicare or insurance below 250% FPL. JPS Connection is the payor of last resort. The online portal may require a JPS medical record number. Citizenship rule was not stated on the page read and was removed; the portal mentions citizenship/immigration status changes, so call to ask. Enrollment center hours and walk-in drop-off not confirmed.

The page says the online application opens at 9 a.m. every other Friday through September (last listed opening Sept 18, 2026) and lists an in-person appointment event on Sept 30, 2026; the schedule after September is not posted, so call. Beat the Heat window AC units are unavailable for the 2026 season. Mailing address: City Hall, 100 Fort Worth Trail, Fort Worth, TX 76102.

records.name: Tarrant Area Food Bank - Find Food
records.description_en: The regional food bank helps you find a nearby food pantry or mobile pantry. It also helps people apply for food benefits like SNAP.
records.description_es: El banco de comida regional le ayuda a encontrar una despensa de comida o una despensa móvil cerca de usted. También ayuda a las personas a solicitar beneficios de comida como SNAP.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone who needs food in Tarrant County and nearby counties. Each pantry may have its own rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona que necesite comida en el condado de Tarrant y condados cercanos. Cada despensa puede tener sus propias reglas.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Find Food map on the website to find a pantry near you, or call 817-857-7100.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use el mapa Find Food (Buscar comida) en el sitio web para encontrar una despensa cerca de usted, o llame al 817-857-7100.
records.hours: Monday - Thursday 8:30 a.m. - 5 p.m.; Friday 8:30 a.m. - 3:30 p.m. (administrative offices)
records.notes: Corrected address: administrative offices are at 2525 Cullen St (Kronick Building); 2600 Cullen St is the distribution center. These are offices/warehouse, not walk-in pantries. SNAP application help: https://tafb.org/apply-for-food-benefits/

records.name: Trinity Metro Reduced Fare
records.description_en: Lower bus and train fares in the Fort Worth area for seniors, people with disabilities, Medicare card holders, youth, and veterans. A local single ride is $1 and a 1-day pass is $2.
records.description_es: Tarifas más bajas de autobús y tren en el área de Fort Worth para personas mayores, personas con discapacidad, personas con tarjeta de Medicare, jóvenes y veteranos. Un viaje local cuesta $1 y un pase de un día cuesta $2.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Seniors 65+, people with disabilities, Medicare card holders, youth ages 5-19, and veterans with proof of status.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de 65 años o más, personas con discapacidad, personas con tarjeta de Medicare, jóvenes de 5 a 19 años y veteranos con comprobante.
documents_needed: Seniors: proof of age (State ID, driver's license, Medicare card, or birth certificate)
Disability: Medicare card, Social Security benefits letter, or VA benefits letter, plus State ID or driver's license
records.how_to_apply: Show valid ID when buying a reduced ticket. You can get a reduced fare photo ID ($2) at the Trinity Metro information kiosk at Fort Worth Central Station, 1001 Jones Street.
records.how_to_apply_es: Muestre una identificación válida al comprar un boleto reducido. Puede sacar una identificación con foto para tarifa reducida ($2) en el quiosco de información de Trinity Metro en Fort Worth Central Station, 1001 Jones Street.
records.cost: Reduced fare: $1 local single ride, $2 1-day pass, $9 7-day pass
records.notes: Eligibility, prices, documents, and kiosk location confirmed. Photo ID card $2 ($10 replacement). Veteran reduced fares valid on local tickets only. No income-based low-income fare listed.

records.name: Legal Aid of NorthWest Texas - Fort Worth Office
records.description_en: Free civil legal help for low-income people, including evictions, tenant problems, foreclosure, family law, debt, and more.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal civil gratuita para personas de bajos ingresos, incluyendo desalojos, problemas con el arrendador, embargos de casa, asuntos de familia, deudas y más.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income individuals and families in its 114-county service area, which includes Tarrant County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas y familias de bajos ingresos en su área de servicio de 114 condados, que incluye el condado de Tarrant.
records.how_to_apply: Call the intake line at 1-888-529-5277 or apply online. For landlord-tenant problems you can also call 855-548-8457.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de admisión al 1-888-529-5277 o haga su solicitud por internet. Para problemas con el arrendador también puede llamar al 855-548-8457.
records.notes: Intake phone, online link, 114-county service area, and Fort Worth administrative office address confirmed. Case types include housing/eviction/foreclosure, family/custody, debt, immigration, income benefits, healthcare coverage, wills. Landlord-tenant hotline 855-548-8457. Exact income limits not stated. If facing an eviction hearing, apply as early as possible.

records.name: Catholic Charities Fort Worth
records.organization: Catholic Charities Diocese of Fort Worth
records.description_en: Services such as immigration legal help, refugee services, pregnancy and parenting support, dental care, transportation, financial coaching, and case management.
records.description_es: Servicios como ayuda legal de inmigración, servicios para refugiados, apoyo durante el embarazo y la crianza, atención dental, transporte, asesoría financiera y apoyo de un trabajador social.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in the 28-county Diocese of Fort Worth. You do not need to be Catholic.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en los 28 condados de la Diócesis de Fort Worth. No necesita ser católico.
records.how_to_apply: Call 817-534-0814 or use the Get Help page on the website.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 817-534-0814 o use la página Get Help (Obtener ayuda) en el sitio web.
records.notes: Phone, address, service area, and service list confirmed. Also 1-800-545-5935; email infocatholiccharities@ccdofw.org. Removed 'employment' category and 'low-cost dental' cost claim, which were not confirmed on the page read. Rent/utility help was not listed.

records.name: The Archway (formerly SafeHaven of Tarrant County)
records.description_en: 24/7 crisis help, safety planning, shelter and housing, support for children, and legal services for survivors of domestic violence.
records.description_es: Ayuda en crisis las 24 horas, plan de seguridad, refugio y vivienda, apoyo para niños y servicios legales para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Survivors of domestic violence in Tarrant County.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica en el condado de Tarrant.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour hotline at 1-877-701-7233 for help or shelter.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda de 24 horas al 1-877-701-7233 para pedir ayuda o refugio.
records.notes: Hotline, office phone (817) 535-6462, address, services, and former name confirmed. Shelter locations are kept confidential; use the hotline. Cost not explicitly stated on the page read.

records.name: Presbyterian Night Shelter Emergency Shelter
records.description_en: Emergency shelter open 24/7 with overnight beds, case management, and help finding housing and work.
records.description_es: Refugio de emergencia abierto las 24 horas, todos los días, con camas para pasar la noche, apoyo de un trabajador social y ayuda para encontrar vivienda y trabajo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone experiencing homelessness.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona que no tenga hogar.
records.how_to_apply: Go to the shelter at 2400 Cypress St. or call 817-632-7400.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al refugio en 2400 Cypress St. o llame al 817-632-7400.
records.notes: Address, phone, 24/7 access, and 'We welcome anyone without a home' confirmed. Also runs True Worth Place day shelter and UpSpire, a social enterprise offering jobs. Meals were not explicitly confirmed on the page read; food category kept because the organization runs True Worth Place, which serves lunch.

records.name: True Worth Place Day Shelter
records.description_en: A daytime resource center for people experiencing homelessness. It has showers, laundry, lunch, a mailing address, phones, computers, case management, and job programs.
records.description_es: Un centro de recursos durante el día para personas sin hogar. Tiene regaderas, lavandería, almuerzo, una dirección para recibir correo, teléfonos, computadoras, apoyo de un trabajador social y programas de empleo.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone experiencing homelessness.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona que no tenga hogar.
records.how_to_apply: Walk in during open hours. When closed, call the Tarrant County Homeless Coalition helpline at 817-996-8800.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llegue sin cita durante el horario de atención. Cuando esté cerrado, llame a la línea de ayuda de Tarrant County Homeless Coalition al 817-996-8800.
records.hours: 7 days a week, 365 days a year, 7:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m.
records.notes: Address, phone, hours, and services confirmed. After-hours helpline (Tarrant County Homeless Coalition): 817-996-8800.

records.name: Arlington Life Shelter
records.description_en: Shelter, meals, case management, job programs, and transitional services for people experiencing homelessness.
records.description_es: Refugio, comidas, apoyo de un trabajador social, programas de empleo y servicios de transición para personas sin hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People experiencing homelessness in North Texas. Entrance requirements apply; call to ask.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas sin hogar en el norte de Texas. Hay requisitos de entrada; llame para preguntar.
records.how_to_apply: Call (817) 548-9885 to ask about intake.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al (817) 548-9885 para preguntar cómo ingresar.
records.notes: Address, phone, and services confirmed. Intake hours and entrance requirements are on a separate page not read; call first.

records.name: Fort Worth Housing Solutions
records.description_en: The Fort Worth housing authority. It runs Housing Choice Vouchers, project-based vouchers, affordable housing, and homelessness programs.
records.description_es: La autoridad de vivienda de Fort Worth. Maneja vales de vivienda (Housing Choice Vouchers), vales basados en proyectos, vivienda asequible y programas para personas sin hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households. Waitlists open only for certain properties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Hogares de bajos ingresos. Las listas de espera solo se abren para ciertas propiedades.
records.how_to_apply: Check which waitlists are open and apply through the online portal, or call 817-333-3400.
records.how_to_apply_es: Revise qué listas de espera están abiertas y presente su solicitud en el portal por internet, o llame al 817-333-3400.
records.notes: Phone, address, hours, programs, and waitlist portal confirmed. Only open waitlist shown: Sedona Village Senior Living (Project-Based Voucher), 2-bedroom units requiring a 3-4 person household. Texas Relay 7-1-1 for hearing impaired. Family self-sufficiency program was not listed on the page read and was removed from the description.

records.name: Arlington Housing Authority
records.organization: City of Arlington - Arlington Housing Authority
records.description_en: Runs the Housing Choice Voucher program, rental assistance, home repair help for homeowners, homeless services, and a family self-sufficiency program in Arlington.
records.description_es: Maneja el programa de vales de vivienda (Housing Choice Vouchers), ayuda con la renta, ayuda para arreglar casas de dueños, servicios para personas sin hogar y un programa para que las familias sean autosuficientes en Arlington.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low and very low-income households, seniors, and people with disabilities in Arlington.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Hogares de bajos y muy bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad en Arlington.
records.how_to_apply: The voucher waiting list is closed right now. Call 817-275-3351 to ask about home repair or other programs.
records.how_to_apply_es: La lista de espera para vales está cerrada por ahora. Llame al 817-275-3351 para preguntar por la ayuda para arreglar casas u otros programas.
records.hours: Office: Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Lobby: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. (closed Wednesdays except document drop-off)
records.notes: Phone, address, hours, programs, and waitlist status confirmed. Page says: due to current funding levels, the voucher waiting list is not expected to open. Email: housingcomments@arlingtonhousing.us.

records.name: Tarrant County Veteran Services
records.description_en: Free help for veterans and survivors to apply for VA and Texas veteran benefits.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratuita para que veteranos y sus sobrevivientes soliciten beneficios del Departamento de Asuntos de Veteranos (VA) y de Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Veterans and their survivors.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Veteranos y sus sobrevivientes.
records.how_to_apply: Call 817-531-5645 for an appointment, or come in for limited walk-in service Tuesday-Friday. Fill out the New Client Intake form.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 817-531-5645 para hacer una cita, o vaya sin cita de martes a viernes (cupo limitado). Llene el formulario de cliente nuevo.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 9 a.m.-3 p.m. by appointment; Tue-Fri 9 a.m.-3 p.m. limited walk-in; closed 12-1 p.m. daily
records.notes: All fields confirmed. Email: VeteranServices@tarrantcountytx.gov

records.name: Recovery Resource Council
records.description_en: Substance use screening, outpatient treatment, recovery support, and counseling for individuals, couples, families, and children. Free mental health services for veterans and their families.
records.description_es: Evaluación y tratamiento ambulatorio por consumo de drogas o alcohol, apoyo para la recuperación y consejería para personas, parejas, familias y niños. Servicios de salud mental gratuitos para veteranos y sus familias.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in its 61-county North Texas, West Texas, and Panhandle service area, which includes Fort Worth. Telehealth is available.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas en su área de servicio de 61 condados en el norte y oeste de Texas y el Panhandle, que incluye Fort Worth. Hay atención por video (telesalud).
records.how_to_apply: Call 817-332-6329 to ask about services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 817-332-6329 para preguntar por los servicios.
records.hours: Monday-Friday 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. (some locations by appointment only)
records.cost: Free for veterans' mental health services; other costs not stated
records.notes: Phone, services, service area, and veteran services confirmed on homepage. Fort Worth address and hours added from https://www.recoverycouncil.org/contact/. Also offers housing assistance and homelessness prevention.
